summary: Recent discussions focus on extending Parquet's logical type system. One thread proposes a VECTOR type that uses MIN_LENGTH and MAX_LENGTH metadata to represent fixed-size numeric vectors without altering physical storage. Another thread introduces a WIRE logical type that keeps raw binary messages while allowing selective shredding of fields for efficient statistics, pruning, and predicate pushdown. A separate discussion references the 1.19.0 release.

highlights.text: Proposal to add a logical VECTOR type using MIN_LENGTH and MAX_LENGTH metadata to encode fixed-size numeric vectors without changing physical storage.

sources.title: Re: [DISCUSS] Numeric Vector type: physical representation (outcome of focused call)

highlights.text: Introduction of a WIRE logical type that preserves raw binary messages while enabling selective columnar shredding of frequently queried fields for statistics, pruning, and predicate pushdown.

sources.title: Re: [DISCUSS] WIRE: a logical type for serialized wire-format messages
